description: A small clear tupperware container with a gray snap-on lid sits on a green cloth-covered table, and a yellow piece of food is visible inside. The left hand steadies the container near the center while the right hand reaches in, flips the side latches, and lifts the lid off; then the right hand reaches into the open container, grasps the yellow piece, and pulls it out to the right while the left hand releases and rests beside the removed lid.
